question: Which dependency-resolution path should OpenClaw use to fix this source-install failure while satisfying build compatibility and dependency-graph approval?
rationale: The remaining fix changes root dependency resolution and generated package artifacts, so ClawSweeper should not choose or approve the final supply-chain boundary from this issue alone.

options.title: Rework the linked fix
options.body: Use the open linked PR as the fix vehicle, but change it to a dependency target that preserves fetch-blob compatibility, regenerates all package artifacts, and gets dependency approval.

options.title: Create a maintainer-owned dependency PR
options.body: Close or leave the external candidate as evidence and have a maintainer carry the selected dependency graph change in an internally generated update.

options.title: Wait for fresh live repro
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause dependency changes until a clean current-main install reproduction confirms the exact resolver failure outside the reporter environment.
